A Prisma schema links a child model Broadcast to a parent model Transmitter through a foreign-key relation. The relation attribute must declare what happens to children when the parent is deleted.

// demo (different domain — a greenhouse app)
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:./dev.db"
}

model Greenhouse {
  id      String   @id @default(cuid())
  sensors Sensor[]

  @@map("greenhouses")
}

model Sensor {
  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  label        String
  reading      Int
  greenhouseId String?
  status       String     @default("calibrating")
  greenhouse   Greenhouse? @relation(fields: [greenhouseId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@map("sensors")
}
